name: matinee
description: ## Install or update (sideload) 1. **Turn on Developer Mode on the Roku** (first time only). On the remote, press Home 3 times, Up 2 times, then Right, Left, Right, Left, Right. Accept the terms, set a password, and let the Roku restart. Write down the IP address it shows. 2. On a computer on the same network, open `http://<roku-ip>` in a browser. Sign in with the username `rokudev` and your password. 3. Click **Upload**, choose `matinee-v2.3.zip`, then click **Install with zip** (or **Replace**). Your server and sign-ins are kept. 4. If Matinee asks, pick your server, then pick your name on **Who's watching?**. Approve the code it shows: in Jellyfin on your phone, go to your profile → **Quick Connect** and enter it. You can also press OK to use your password.
